json.justification: Before the install began (Photo 1), the meter sits on a single-story brick wall with open wall to the right of the panel for the disconnect and a clear wall below the meter for the conduit. There is open dirt and lawn ground with full headroom beneath the high eave, both left of the meter toward the corner and along the wall toward the window. No gas meter, window well, door, garage or driveway is near those stretches, the only window is raised and well away from the corner-side spot, and the batteries were later installed in exactly these spots.
